title: Sexual Attraction
summary: Sexual attraction is feeling drawn to someone in a sexual way — wanting physical or sexual closeness with them. It is different from romantic attraction (wanting a romantic relationship) and aesthetic attraction (finding someone good-looking).
key_points: You can feel one kind of attraction without the others.
Feeling attracted to someone doesn't oblige you to act on it.
Attraction patterns are part of sexual orientation.
